title: Defining the Relationship
description: After months of dating, your partner Riley sits you down at a coffee shop. 'Where is this going?' they ask. Your heart races. You've been avoiding this conversation, telling yourself the status quo works. But Riley wants clarity—a future together or a clean break.

outcomes.narration: You take Riley's hand. 'I want this. Us. A real future.' Tears well in their eyes—relief, joy, love. You talk until the coffee shop closes, making plans, dreaming out loud. Something real begins.

You explain your hesitation—career instability, fear of losing yourself, the weight of commitment. Riley listens, nods slowly. 'I understand. But I can't wait forever.' They leave kindly, and you spend the night wondering if you just let something precious slip away.

You explain that you care for Riley but can't see a future. The words hurt both of you. Riley cries, you cry, and you walk home alone through cold autumn air. It feels like grief—but also like clarity.
